name: file-tree
title: File Tree
description: A component used to showcase the folder and file structure of a directory.

examples.name: file-tree-demo
examples.title: From data
examples.description: Pass `elements`; siblings are sorted folders-first and alphabetically (`sort="none"` keeps your order).

examples.name: file-tree-composed
examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Build the tree from `Folder` / `File` components and add a `CollapseButton`.

examples.name: file-tree-icons
examples.title: Custom icons
examples.description: `openIcon`, `closeIcon` and `fileIcon` take any node; `onSelect` reports the clicked id.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper. Other div props are passed to it.

props.name: elements
props.description: Data to render when `children` are omitted.

props.name: initialSelectedId
props.description: Id of the item selected at first; its parent folders are expanded.

props.name: initialExpandedItems
props.description: Ids of the folders expanded at first.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Show the vertical guide line inside expanded folders.

props.name: openIcon
props.description: Icon for expanded folders.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Icon for collapsed folders.

props.name: sort
props.description: Sorting for data-driven trees: folders first then alphabetical, input order, or your comparator.

props.name: dir
props.description: Text direction.

props.name: children
props.description: `Folder` / `File` / `CollapseButton` elements. When provided, `elements` is not rendered.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a folder or file is selected. Not in Magic UI.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the folder's button. Other div props go on the folder's wrapper.

props.name: element
props.description: Folder name.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique id, used for selection and expansion.

props.name: isSelectable
props.description: Whether the folder can be selected and opened.

props.name: isSelect
props.description: Force the selected state.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested `Folder` / `File` elements.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the file's button. Other button props are passed through.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique id, used for selection.

props.name: isSelectable
props.description: Whether the file can be selected.

props.name: isSelect
props.description: Force the selected state.

props.name: fileIcon
props.description: Custom icon.

props.name: children
props.description: The file name.

props.name: handleSelect
props.description: Called with `value` when the file is clicked.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the button (absolutely positioned bottom-end by default).

props.name: elements
props.description: The tree's data, used to find every folder.

props.name: expandAll
props.description: Expand every folder straight away.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content, e.g. an icon. Clicking collapses everything, or expands everything when all are collapsed.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier.

props.name: name
props.description: Label shown for the node.

props.name: type
props.description: Explicit node type. Use `"folder"` for empty folders.

props.name: isSelectable
props.description: Whether the node can be selected.

props.name: children
props.description: Child nodes.
